description.value: Michi Craft Kitchen is a Chinese-Filipino fusion restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, known for its 'Michi' grilled rice skewers and a menu that blends Cantonese comfort food with Filipino merienda snacks. The restaurant offers indoor seating in a unit within a Kingsway strip, with an active online ordering system for pickup. Its diverse menu — spanning grilled rice, omelette rice bowls, dry noodles, spaghetti, toast, and fresh beverages — makes it a versatile stop for a hungry cyclist.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 21m; stands (2 spaces) at 47m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and operating at #180-3665 Kingsway, Vancouver, matching the OSM address, phone, and name. The site offers online ordering for pickup ('Order online & skip the line!', 'Order for Pick-up'), confirming takeout service. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by active website with online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists on Kingsway.
